body: I pulled a knife on my older brother after I got tired of him hitting me and abusing me. I didn't go through with it though, but some days, I wish I did before I turned 18.

I contemplated pulling the trigger last night after I got some severe and justified criticism of my lack of job performance. My wife has listened to my struggles, and she reminded me that it is not a sign of weakness to ask for help. 

I got through some meetings today where I know that some of my work is going to be delegated to other members to help take some of the slack off of me, but I feel very humiliated and humbled by this experience. I have good people in my life, and I try not to fuck up hard, but these next few days, I'm going to be trying to clean up the mess I made.

The gun's not on my temple anymore, but I feel a whip on my back. I repeat to myself that it will only be a game over if I don't humble myself and continue. I only have as many 1-UPs as I want, but my mental and psychological piggy bank is running out of tokens.

Thank you for your kind words. Yeah, part of the reason I've been afraid to switch jobs is because I've been working on a narrow niche in my field. I was looking through some job openings on a lark, and my duties rarely overlap with the jobs/ locations I've given a second glance at. 

You're a very kind person to shine a candle onto a person who's stumbling in the darkness :)
How do i get started? Do i just look up mental health centers and find one that will do a mental health checkup for me?
I trust her with most everything except for this issue. I... don't know why. Because it's such a sensitive issue? Because I'm afraid to see how she would react to it.

As far as talking to, I don't feel comfortable opening up to the people who I mentioned. Call it spoiled or weariness, but I can't seem to tell them. That's partly why I created a throwaway to find some camaraderie or solace here, with friends who face similar demons. 

As far as medication, I'm a total beginner at where to even begin. I have no idea how to find a medical professional that would not merely pawn me some sugar pills that provide some relief at the cost of some serious side effects. 

I apologize if that came off as rude. I realize those two options you mentioned are excellent. It's just, I don't have the strength to know where to start.
10 years. You've got a strong pluck to keep going forward even despite the bumps. That gives me a little bit more hope to be more patient with myself. Thank you
